title: `ia author` writes what the same `ia preview` form showed, and `ia author system` writes a starter system
summary: @inventarch/cli adds `ia author` (catalog row: mode author, move Synthesis). Every `ia preview` form that changes a record has an author form with the same arguments and --digest <sha256>, the target file's sha256 the preview printed (an absent file and an empty one read alike). It compiles the candidate again against one editor snapshot, judged for the author mode, and writes it only when the file is still the one the digest names and the candidate is clean (no error counts against it, as preview counts them). The record written carries one attribution comment above it, `# authored-by @agent <participant> under @mandate <name> at <authored revision>`: the acting participant, the first governing mandate that binds it and grants Synthesis, and the workspace's authored revision the candidate was compiled against; a second author replaces the comment rather than stacking one, and capture membership does not record it. An existing file is read again through db's opened-handle reader just before the write and written by the distribution's replace (a temporary file and a rename, every component checked for links), keeping its permission bits; a new file by createFile, which refuses an entry that appeared since. The edit is spliced into the file as it is, so line endings, a byte-order mark and every other record's bytes are kept, and only the target record's digest moves (or the new record appears). `ia author system <name>` writes init's starter system (`@system <name>` and its steward `@agent <name>-steward`) to .ia/src/systems/<name>/system.ia, a file that must not exist yet, and names `ia author --set <workspace> "composition.systems+=@system <name>" --digest <workspace file sha256>` as its next command; `ia preview system <name>` shows it first. Refusals: preview's for the same form, plus a missing or malformed --digest (IA-CLI-USAGE, exit 2), a file that is not the one the digest names or that changed, appeared or disappeared while authored (IA-CLI-EDIT-STALE, exit 1), a candidate with an error that counts against it (IA-CLI-EDIT-UNCLEAN, exit 1) and a write the volume refuses (the distribution's code, exit 3); each names the preview of the same form, and a refusal writes nothing. Limits: an actor may author edits to the records that restrict it (its own `@mandate`, the workspace's `composition.steward`) wherever its mandates grant Synthesis and do not exclude the `mandate` or `workspace` word, pending an operator decision; the attribution is a comment, not authentication; one record, row or field is written per invocation, and generic `@operation` execution is not part of this change.
